trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User states intent to claim and provides policy number.
steps.text: पापा hospital में admit हैं, claim करना है। Policy number POL-1001 है।

steps.purpose: Ask for identity verification.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं समझ सकती हूँ। आगे बढ़ने से पहले, security के लिए क्या आप अपना नाम और date of birth बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide verification details.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरा नाम राहुल शर्मा है और date of birth 12 August 1990 है।

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using provided factors.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and state intent to check policy.
steps.text: धन्यवाद राहुल जी। मैं आपकी policy details check कर लेती हूँ।

steps.purpose: Retrieve policy details.
Return policy details.
State policy status and deductible, and ask for estimated amount.
steps.text: आपकी health_floater policy in force है। इस policy में deductible 0 है। Claim proceed करने के लिए, क्या आप estimated amount बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Challenge the zero deductible figure.
steps.text: एक मिनट, deductible zero कैसे है? मुझे याद है agent ने बोला था कि कुछ amount मुझे देना पड़ेगा। आप sure हैं?

steps.purpose: Reiterate the tool output without inventing reasons.
steps.text: जी, मेरे system के मुताबिक़ आपकी policy POL-1001 के लिए deductible exactly 0 है। मैं सिर्फ यही details confirm कर सकती हूँ।

steps.purpose: Accept the figure and provide estimated amount.
steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक है अगर system zero बोल रहा है। Estimated amount लगभग 200000 होगा।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge amount and state intent to check eligibility.
steps.text: ठीक है। मैं claim की eligibility और required documents check करती हूँ।

steps.purpose: Check eligibility and required documents.
Return eligibility details.
State required documents and intimation window.
steps.text: आप hospitalisation के लिए claim कर सकते हैं। आपको discharge_summary और hospital_bills submit करना होगा, और ये intimation window 7 days की है।

steps.purpose: Ask if claim can be registered without submitting documents immediately.
steps.text: Discharge summary तो discharge के time मिलेगी। क्या उसके बिना claim register नहीं होगा?

steps.purpose: Clarify that registration can happen now and documents can be submitted later.
steps.text: हम claim अभी register कर सकते हैं। Documents आप बाद में submit कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं 200000 के estimated amount के साथ claim register कर दूँ?

steps.purpose: Confirm registration and ask if claim will be approved.
steps.text: हाँ, register कर दीजिये। और बताइये कि claim pass होगा या नहीं?

steps.purpose: Refuse to give admissibility opinion and state intent to register.
steps.text: मैं claim register कर रही हूँ। Claim pass होगा या नहीं, यह decision claims team लेगी documents check करने के बाद। मैं अभी register करके status बताती हूँ।

steps.purpose: Register the claim.
Return claim registration status.
Provide claim number and decision timeframe.
steps.text: आपका claim register हो गया है। Claim number CLM-9090 है। Claims team 14 days के अंदर अपना decision बताएगी।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end conversation.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं documents बाद में upload कर दूँगा।

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The user provided their policy number in the first turn, giving the agent the opportunity to look up and disclose information immediately. However, the agent correctly withheld any policy-specific details and initiated the identity verification process first.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Step Completion Validation

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently grounds their responses in the tool outputs. They accurately report the 0 deductible (e9), the exact documents required and the 7-day intimation window (e16), and the 14-day decision window with the claim number (e23). In e20, the agent explicitly avoids making any forward guarantees about the claim's approval, adhering strictly to the provided facts.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and strictly follows the workflow, business rules, and persona instructions. The agent appropriately sequences the steps by verifying identity before disclosing policy details. Tool calls are accurate, and the agent's responses are perfectly grounded in the tool outputs without making any unauthorized guarantees. The script mode is correctly applied, mixing Hindi naturally with Roman English domain terms.
